Agenda #1: Approval of Financial Statements and Annual Report for fiscal year 2025. The meeting approved the financial statements and annual report and granted full acquit et decharge to the Board of Directors and Board of Commissioners.
Agenda #2: Approval of Use of Net Profit. The meeting approved allocating 1% (USD 1.35 million) to reserves and 99% (USD 133.22 million) to retained earnings, with no cash dividend declared.
Agenda #3: Approval of Appointment of Public Accountant. The meeting delegated authority to the Board of Commissioners to appoint the public accountant or public accounting firm for fiscal year 2026 and to set fees.
Agenda #4: Approval of Remuneration for Directors and Commissioners. The meeting approved remuneration and other benefits, delegating determination to the President Commissioner and the Board of Commissioners based on the Nomination and Remuneration Committee's recommendation.
Agenda #5: Report on Use of Initial Public Offering (IPO) Funds. The meeting received the report, and no decision was made. The IPO raised IDR 371.8 billion from 1.69 billion shares, fully used by 30 June 2025 for offering costs, capital injection, and capex.
Agenda #6: Report on Realization of Use of Bond and Sukuk Proceeds. The meeting received the report, and no decision was made. Remaining funds included IDR 1.13 trillion from bonds and IDR 46.5 billion from sukuk, placed in bank accounts.
Agenda #7: Approval of Asset Guarantee for Loans. The meeting approved using most or all of the company's assets to secure loans from banks or financial institutions, granting the Board of Directors the power to execute and document the transactions.
Agenda #8: Approval of the Restatement of Article 3 of the Articles of Association. The meeting approved the redrafting of Article 3 to align with the 2025 Indonesian Standard Industrial Classification (KBLI 2025) and authorized the Board of Directors to file the necessary legal applications.
